newsitem.title: USA: Central Fidelity may buy extra 3mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Central Fidelity may buy extra 3mln shares.

text.p: Central Fidelity Banks Inc said Thursday it may buy up to 3 million more shares of its common stock under a repurchase program that began in January.
To date, the company said it has repurchased the equivalent of about 2.6 million shares after giving effect to a 3-for-2 stock split which occurred June 14.
The newly authorized 3 million shares together with the 400,000 shares remaining under the original program represent about 5.8 percent of the outstanding stock.
The bank said it expects this extension to its repurchase program will be accomplished over the next 18 to 24 months.
